eas_text: A civil authority has issued A REQUIRED WEEKLY TEST for the following counties or areas: New Mexico; at 3:41 PM on AUG 19, 2016 Effective until 4:11 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: THIS IS A WEEKLY TEST OF THE EMERGENCY ALERT SYSTEM. THIS IS ONLY A TEST.
